references.text: The prophecy of the Lord's feast on Mount Zion, which points forward to the meal Jesus speaks about.
Parallel event in the Gospel of Mark where Jesus speaks about drinking new wine in the kingdom of God.
Parallel event in the Gospel of Luke where Jesus speaks about not drinking from the vine until the kingdom of God comes.
Reference to the wedding feast at the Lamb's wedding, which is a continuation of the theme of the meal in the kingdom of God.
